:yt: :stopwatch-blue-hand-timer: TIMESTAMPS & Summary: Meta's Llama 4 introduces a new family of AI models, highlighted by the Llama 4 Scout's industry-leading 10 million token context window, aiming to outperform competitors and promote open-source AI development.
0:00 🚀 Llama 4: Meta's New AI Models
• Meta released Llama 4, aiming to reclaim leadership in open-source AI.
• Llama 4 Scout features an industry-leading 10 million token context window, surpassing competitors like Gemini 2.5 Pro.
• The model family includes Llama 4 Scout (17B active parameters, 10M context), Maverick (17B, multimodal, 1M context), and Behemoth (288B active parameters).

1:36 ⚙️ Model Tiers and Specifications
• Llama 4 Scout has 17 billion active parameters and 16 experts, optimized for speed.
• Llama 4 Maverick is multimodal with a 1 million token context length, enabling image and video understanding.
• Llama 4 Behemoth has 288 billion active parameters and 2 trillion total parameters, designed as a teacher model for distillation.

3:12 🏆 Performance Benchmarks
• Llama 4 Scout outperforms Gemma 3, Gemini 2.0, and Mixtral 3.1 in context window tasks.
• Llama 4 Maverick beats GPT-4.0 and Gemini 2.0 Flash, with comparable reasoning and coding to DeepSeek V3 at half the parameters.
• Llama 4 Behemoth outperforms GPT-4.5, Claude Sonnet 3.7, and Gemini 2.0 Pro on STEM benchmarks, ideal for creating synthetic training data.

5:10 🌍 Open Source Strategy
• Meta emphasizes that open source drives innovation and benefits developers, Meta, and the world.
• China is releasing competitive open-source AI and robotics models, potentially challenging US big tech's dominance.
• Meta aims to lead in open-source AI, with more announcements expected at Llama Con on April 29th.

6:32 🧠 Mixture of Experts Architecture
• Meta's Llama 4 uses a mixture of experts (MoE) architecture for compute efficiency, activating only a fraction of parameters per token.
• MoE models offer higher quality compared to dense models with a fixed training budget, crucial given GPU shortages.
• Llama models demonstrate reasonable costs per million input/output tokens, outperforming GPT-4.0 in image reasoning and understanding.

8:26 🔍 Context Window and Licensing
• Llama 4 Scout (10M token window) addresses early issues with large context lengths, performing well in needle-in-a-haystack tests for text and video.
• The two trillion parameter Behemoth serves as a teacher model, excelling in non-reasoning tasks like math, multilinguality, and image benchmarks.
• The Llama license is not fully open source, prohibiting use/distribution in the EU, though some exemptions exist for non-EU companies and employees.

11:36 🤔 Llama for Reasoning and Future Plans
• Llama for Reasoning is anticipated, indicated by a teaser URL.
• The creator plans to dive in and test these models soon.
